test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following scientific research institutes topped in the National Ranking Index 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**CSIR.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **CSIR institutes topped the National Ranking Index 2020.**
 
• The CSIR of Delhi topped the National Ranking Index 2020 which ranks scientific research institutes.
 
• CSIR was followed by IISc Bangalore.
 
• The** first rank holder CSIR** had a share percentage of **87.74 and 142 counts.**
 
• Followed by** CSIR, IISC Bangalore** had a share percentage of **83.61 and 211 counts.**
 
• The third rank was won by the **Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) **with a share percentage of** 62.18 and 232 counts.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Council of Scientific & Industrial Research
 
• It was established by the Government of India in September 1942 as an autonomous body. 
 
 
• It comes under the Ministry of Science & Technology.
